identity.name: Anchor Cleaver
identity.summary: An anchor shaped chopping blade on a short rope wrapped haft.
identity.description: Costs 2 stamina per activation. Deals 12 physical damage per affordable activation. Warrior only: requires and spends 2 Momentum; adds 3 damage for each Momentum spent. No cost is spent if activation is unaffordable.
identity.lore: Salvaged from a warship that never reached the sea.

effects.description: Costs 2 stamina per activation. Deals 12 physical damage per affordable activation. Warrior only: requires and spends 2 Momentum; adds 3 damage for each Momentum spent. No cost is spent if activation is unaffordable.
effects.condition: Equipped; class restriction satisfied; all activation costs can be paid together.

synergies.description: Orthogonal adjacency support and available mana/stamina determine the best arrangement. Strategic combinations grant no unlisted bonus.

conditions: All ingredients are packed, unlocked, nonpermanent and form one orthogonally connected group.
recipes.failureBehavior: Incomplete, disconnected or locked inputs consume nothing. A complete recipe always consumes its inputs; an output that cannot fit enters the stash.
recipes.description: Combine Hooked Falchion, Iron Charm into Anchor Cleaver.
